best_hook.why: An old nobleman rams his cane into a younger man's chest and pins him to the wall - a violent, startling opener.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch' - a death sentence is decided and the trial has not happened yet.

must_promos.why: Cane pin and 'you burn them!' escalate into a plan to frame the prisoner as a poisoner, cut on 'Then call it witchcraft.'
'She will hang' and the arrest warrant, ending on the chained, shivering heroine in the flooded cell, who does not yet know what is coming.

standalone_risk: Juliana is off screen until the last seconds, so 'she', 'the prisoner' and 'the Ashcroft girl' are unclear to a stranger; the Duchess poisoning and who the Elder Nobleman is are not explained.
notes: A deadly threat built step by step; strongest when the cut ends on the heroine's face so the target is visible.
